name: Cora
description: Bold off-white Inter on one line, with the occasional caption set as a cover poster wherever one of its words can carry it: tight black-weight Inter around that word, huge, in Fraunces italic with a yellow-to-orange gradient, each word appearing as it is said. The stressed word between posters in warm yellow. Loud, warm magazine-cover look for talking-head videos; needs no tags.
